sentences.text: In short: IDÉKLEKKERIET AS is an established company in "utgivelse av bøker" based in Kristiansand, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
IDÉKLEKKERIET AS is registered in the industry "Utgivelse av bøker"; its registered activity is "Fremstilling og salg av undervisningsmateriell.".
IDÉKLEKKERIET AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2012-07-01, registered in Kristiansand.
It reported revenue of NOK 1.80M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 509,775 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 28.3% and negative equity of -NOK 22,466 (liabilities exceed assets).
Revenue rose 44.5% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 1.25M to NOK 1.80M); it was NOK 1.05M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in 2025, as in 2024 (2023: -NOK 455,317, 2024: NOK 21,110, 2025: NOK 510,298).
IDÉKLEKKERIET AS is led by board chair Nikolai Grønn Høibo.
It has a board of 2. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2025-08-08.
